summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs with coordinates computed from padded slices; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset reworked to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; PatchDataset docstring float fix; math import removed, PatchIter added to __all__); monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter); docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry); tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array). Nothing was run and nothing was committed, per instructions. Unverified: the pinned values in test_loading_array depend on image contents the spec does not give; I used np.arange(16, dtype=float).reshape(1, 4, 4) for both images, so that test may fail if the pinned values came from different images. Pre-existing lines over 120 characters remain in utils.py at lines 232-234, outside my edits.
